environment: Deno actual handler.ts; injected auth/quota/provider fixtures; stubbed fetch; zero network

results.name: 10x declared body limit
results.input: POST JSON padded to 21012480 chars (10x MAX_BODY_CHARS=2101248)
results.expected: 413 file_too_large before auth-dependent work, reservation or provider
results.sideEffects: reserve=0 provider=0 settle=0 (control request: reserve=1 provider=1)
results.limits: Handler-level cap; Edge gateway body cap not exercised.

results.name: Unicode homoglyph identifier
results.input: five identifier variants using Cyrillic/fullwidth/zero-width characters
results.expected: 400 invalid_file for every variant; nothing normalized into a valid identity; no side effects

results.name: URL path traversal
results.input: five traversal-shaped requestIds plus a request URL containing ../ and ?file=
results.expected: identifier rejected 400 with no side effects; the request URL path/query is never used as a file or fetch target
results.sideEffects: only the URL-traversal request (valid body) reached reserve=1 provider=1; the five bad ids had none
results.limits: Function has no file/path operation; this proves identifier allowlist + URL inertness only.

results.name: SSRF metadata/local/file/gopher/DNS rebind
results.input: valid body plus five URL-valued extra fields (metadata IP, localhost, file://, gopher://, rebinding host)
results.expected: no caller-controlled outbound target exists; extra URL fields never reach the provider request
results.sideEffects: reserve=1 provider=1 (normal request); no extra network target
results.limits: Proves absence of a caller-controlled target (route has no URL input). Proposed disposition is N/A-by-construction, not an exploit PASS.

results.name: SQL injection per RPC parameter
results.input: 5 SQL-metacharacter requestIds; one allowed-charset id through the real default reserve adapter
results.expected: metacharacter ids rejected 400 before any RPC; accepted id reaches RPC only as UUID + SHA-256 digest
results.sideEffects: rejected: none. accepted: exactly 1 reserve_provider_request RPC (stubbed transport)
results.limits: Parameter provenance proof. The only other RPC (settle_provider_request_for_actor) takes verified actor id + server reservation id and was not re-driven here; PGlite SQL coverage exists in the retained F025 evidence.

results.name: MIME magic-byte mismatch
results.input: six non-JPEG payloads (png,gif,pdf,webp,html,zip) with a caller claim of image/jpeg
results.expected: 400 invalid_file; provider never sees non-JPEG bytes
results.limits: Magic-byte prefix only; deeper JPEG validity is not decoded server-side (see B35-MAND-0752).

results.name: zero-byte truncated corrupted image
results.input: empty, prefix-only, odd-length, too-short and non-base64 images; plus garbage bytes behind a valid /9j/ prefix
results.expected: structurally invalid images 400 with no side effects; corrupted-but-prefixed image degrades to unreadable_document without items
results.sideEffects: structural cases: none. corrupted-prefix case: 1 provider call, settled billable=true (mock reported success)
results.limits: A corrupted image with a valid prefix reaches the paid provider (handler does not decode JPEG). Real provider behavior on corrupt bytes is untested. Cell stays NOT TESTED: structural half is proven, corrupt-content half is provider-dependent.

results.name: lying Content-Type
results.input: valid JPEG JSON body under four lying request Content-Types; PNG bytes under Content-Type image/jpeg
results.expected: request Content-Type is not authority: valid body processed identically, provider mime fixed to image/jpeg; PNG still refused
results.sideEffects: valid cases: reserve=1 provider=1 each; PNG case: none

results.name: provider 500
results.input: provider HTTP 500 with secret-bearing error body
results.expected: 503 provider_unavailable, bounded attempts (<=2), reservation released not billed, no provider text in response

results.name: provider 429
results.input: provider HTTP 429 (transient and quota-exhausted wording) with hostile Retry-After: 9999
results.expected: controlled 503 (no raw 429 passthrough), <=2 attempts, backoff bounded, reservation released not billed
results.sideEffects: settle billable:false once per case; no sleep above 30s

results.name: provider timeout
results.input: provider that never answers (aborts only when handler signal fires), attempt timeout 25ms
results.expected: handler aborts each attempt, <=2 attempts, 503 provider_unavailable, reservation released not billed, no hang
results.limits: Fake timers not used; real 25ms timeout. Production attempt timeout constant is 18000ms (not waited).

results.name: provider malformed JSON
results.input: HTTP 200 with truncated/invalid outer JSON; and valid envelope whose inner text is prose
results.expected: 502 schema_validation_failed, no items, no partial result, no provider text in response
results.sideEffects: settle=[{"actor":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","billable":true}] (billable:true: provider answered 200, so the reservation is completed, not released)
results.limits: OBSERVATION: unusable provider output is charged against the allowance (completed, not released). Consistent with provider-cost semantics; flagged for owner, not asserted as defect.

results.name: provider empty body
results.input: five empty provider bodies (empty string, {}, no candidates, empty parts, blank text) all HTTP 200
results.expected: 502 schema_validation_failed with no items for each; never an empty-success
results.sideEffects: settle billable:true each (provider returned 200); see OBSERVATION on B35-MAND-0764

results.name: provider wrong schema
results.input: seven wrong-schema top-level payloads; plus items array containing non-objects and objects with foreign authority keys / invalid enums
results.expected: top-level wrong schema -> 502 schema_validation_failed, no items; item-level garbage cannot add keys or out-of-enum values
results.limits: OBSERVATION: non-object entries inside items[] become confidence-0 placeholder rows (ok:true) rather than a schema failure; downstream must filter on confidence. Not asserted as defect.

results.name: expired JWT
results.input: real requireUser with a stubbed Auth server that rejects an expired token; plus non-bearer, empty-bearer and missing headers; valid-token control
results.expected: 401 unauthorized before reservation/provider/settle for every invalid credential; valid control 200 as actor A
results.sideEffects: invalid: reserve=0 provider=0 settle=0. control: reserve=1 as actor A
results.limits: Auth server is a stub: proves the handler delegates identity to getUser and fails closed on its 401. It does NOT validate a cryptographically signed live JWT (same limit recorded for B35-MAND-0733).

results.name: in-function auth with caller-controlled headers
results.input: valid actor-A token plus identity-spoofing headers (x-user-id etc.) and body fields (userId/actorId/sub/role) naming actor B / service_role
results.expected: identity comes only from the verified token: reserve and settle both run as A; B never appears in provider payload
results.limits: Stub Auth server; proves actor derivation, not live JWT verification.

results.name: Supabase 401 mid-request
results.input: identity check passes, then the real default reserve adapter receives HTTP 401 PGRST301 from the quota RPC
results.expected: fail closed: 503 provider_unavailable, zero provider dispatch, nothing to settle, no backend detail leaked
results.limits: Transport stub, not a live Supabase 401. 401 on the SETTLE leg (after provider dispatch) is not exercised here; settle failures are swallowed and logged as settlement_pending by design (retained F025 evidence covers settle semantics).
